title: Enablement Kit — Multi-Factor Authentication & Conditional Access
author_notes: Enablement Kit. Distinct from the CA *implementation* products (ENTZTCA + Conditional Access Integration) — this is team enablement/labs; cross-reference. Report-only-first. PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph / Az) + KQL. Cross-references existing Entra solutions (ENTPIM/ENTPASSKEY/ENTZTCA/ENTIGA, Conditional Access Integration, Hybrid Identity, SAML App Factory, enterprise-app governance) rather than duplicating them (gap-only). Change scripts -WhatIf/report-only-first + break-glass; licensing (P1/P2/Governance/GSA/Verified ID) + preview flagged verify.
